checkpoints.note: On the saved crashing path, the current RAR5 FILE/SERVICE extra-field ID decodes as `EX_UOWNER`, so `process_head_file_extra()` enters `parse_file_extra_owner()`. The surrounding stack frames at `process_head_file:1618`, `process_head_service:1670`, and `process_base_block:1921` show that this happens while parsing a RAR5 service header's extra data.
This read decodes the owner-field flags varint. The later `if ((flags & OWNER_GROUP_NAME) != 0)` check at line 1366 uses this decoded state to select the crashing group-name branch.

On the crashing path, the parsed group-name length is large enough that this code leaves `name_len == OWNER_MAXNAMELEN`. The later terminator store at line 1377 therefore targets index 256 of `namebuf[256]`. The staged patch fixes the exact obligation by changing the threshold to `>= OWNER_MAXNAMELEN` and truncating to `OWNER_MAXNAMELEN - 1` before the terminator write.
